title: Field modifiers (:attr) apply to verb-valued mappings
purpose: A trailing field modifier after a verb-valued mapping (x = %verb ... :attr) attaches to the mapping, not the verb's last argument. So a computed value can be emitted as an XML attribute, matching the path-valued form.
notes: The :attr modifier after the %upper verb expression belongs to the producerCode mapping; it must not be consumed as the verb's last argument.
producerCode therefore renders as an attribute on the Quote element, while total (no :attr) stays a child element.
Argument-level directives such as :pos and :len still attach to verb arguments; only field modifiers (:attr, :required, :confidential, :deprecated, :redacted) bubble up to the mapping.
